name: Måneskin

whyMatters.en: Rome four-piece formed in 2016. Eurovision 2021 win with Zitti e buoni, plus streaming hits Beggin' (Four Seasons cover) and I Wanna Be Your Slave (2021), put Italian glam-garage hard rock on 2020s rock radio and playlists.
whyMatters.zh: 罗马四人组，2016 年成立。2021 年以《Zitti e buoni》获 Eurovision，加上流媒体热单《Beggin'》（Four Seasons 翻唱）与《I Wanna Be Your Slave》（2021），把意大利 glam-garage hard rock 送上 2020 年代摇滚电台与歌单。

lyricQuotes: I wanna be your slave / I wanna be your master
Put your hands up in the air

shortBio.en: Rome glam-garage four; Eurovision Zitti e buoni, Beggin' and Slave as 2020s streaming rock hits.
shortBio.zh: 罗马 glam-garage 四人；Eurovision《Zitti e buoni》，《Beggin'》与 Slave 作 2020 年代流媒体摇滚热单。

body.en:
Måneskin formed in Rome (Monteverde) in 2016. The Teatro d’Ira period and the Eurovision 2021 win with Zitti e buoni put the four on continental TV. Beggin' (Four Seasons cover, live-in-studio style) became a 2020–21 streaming breakout; Teatro d’Ira - Vol. I yielded I Wanna Be Your Slave—glam shout, De Angelis bass-forward mix, Raggi riff.

Rush! (2022) adds The Loneliest as a ballad single. Writing stays close to 1970s hard-rock/glam attitude, cut with indie-modern production and social-video distribution.
body.zh:
Måneskin 于 2016 年在罗马（Monteverde）成立。Teatro d’Ira 期与 2021 Eurovision 凭《Zitti e buoni》夺冠，把四人推上欧洲电视。《Beggin'》（Four Seasons 翻唱，现场录音室风）成 2020–21 流媒体爆发；《Teatro d’Ira - Vol. I》产出《I Wanna Be Your Slave》——glam 喊叫、De Angelis 贝斯靠前混音、Raggi riff。

《Rush!》（2022）加入谣曲单曲《The Loneliest》。写法接近 70 年代 hard-rock/glam 态度，配 indie-modern 制作与社交视频分发。

note.zh: Four Seasons 翻唱；2020–21 流媒体爆发演出版。

note.zh: Eurovision 2021 冠军；意大利语 hard-rock 电视地标。

title.zh: 经流媒体与 Eurovision 的 glam-garage

body.en:
Måneskin write short glam hard-rock songs with David’s shout vocal and De Angelis bass as mix center—closer to Stones/Zeppelin attitude than indie whisper.

Beggin' shows cover reach in the TikTok window; Slave and Zitti e buoni show original catalog punch.

Distribution path is TV contest plus streaming, not 1990s college radio.
body.zh:
Måneskin 写短 glam hard-rock，David 喊叫人声、De Angelis 贝斯作混音中心——更近 Stones/Zeppelin 态度，而非 indie 耳语。

《Beggin'》显示 TikTok 窗口的翻唱触达；Slave 与《Zitti e buoni》显示原创目录冲击。

分发路径是电视赛事加流媒体，而非 1990 年代学院电台。

title.zh: 同学以来稳定罗马四人

body.en:
David, De Angelis, Raggi, and Torchio formed as teens and have stayed the same four from street busking through Eurovision and Rush!.

Writing credits are often shared; stage roles stay fixed. Peak global visibility is the 2021 Teatro d’Ira / Eurovision year.
body.zh:
David、De Angelis、Raggi、Torchio 青少年组建，从街头到 Eurovision 与《Rush!》仍是同一四人。

写作常共享；舞台角色固定。全球可见度高峰是 2021 Teatro d’Ira / Eurovision 年。

title.zh: 2020 年代欧洲摇滚电台面孔

body.en:
Citation path: 1970s glam/hard-rock vocabulary through Italian language and social video. Geography differs from Strokes/Arctic Monkeys revival peers; attitude overlaps.

Immediate impact is charting a rock four-piece in the streaming decade. Craft rests on simple riffs and consistent visual presentation.
body.zh:
引用路径：70 年代 glam/hard-rock 语汇经意大利语与社交视频。地理不同于 Strokes/Arctic Monkeys 复古同辈；态度有重叠。

即时影响是让摇滚四人组在流媒体十年上榜。工艺落在简单 riff 与一致的视觉呈现。
